songs.lyrics:
[intro]

[hook intro]
Let It Run All Night

[verse 1]
One lamp on the desk and the window gone black
Headphones half off, one ear on the room
The clock says late but the loop says stay
Cold coffee ring on the notebook page
Nothing outside is asking for me now

[chorus]
Let It Run All Night, I'll follow where it goes
Eight bars turning over like a wheel
Nobody's counting hours in here
Let the night carry what I can't say

[breakdown]

[verse 2]
The street is done, the last bus went by
My hands know the shape of this without me
Save it, name it, play it again
Somewhere a neighbour turns over in bed
Nothing outside is asking for me now

[chorus]
Eight bars turning over like a wheel
Let It Run All Night, I'll follow where it goes
Nobody's counting hours in here
Let the night carry what I can't say

[instrumental break]

[bridge]
I was going to fix the whole thing tonight
Instead I fixed one bar and let it breathe

[final chorus]
Let It Run All Night, I'll follow where it goes
Eight bars turning over like a wheel
Nobody's counting hours in here
The window's going grey and I don't mind
Let It Run All Night, I'll follow where it goes

[outro]

songs.lyrics:
[intro]

[hook intro]
I'm Coming Home

[verse 1]
Red light, and a hundred coats stop with you
Steam off the grate, a bag against your knee
The sign above the corner blinks and holds
You count the seconds like you always do

[pre-chorus]
Nothing here belongs to anyone tonight
The city just keeps handing itself around

[chorus]
I'm Coming Home, the light is going to change
Shoulders and headlights, all of it moving
You step off the curb into the middle of it
And it carries you the way water would

[breakdown]

[verse 2]
Green, and the whole block exhales at once
Somebody laughs behind you, gone in a step
A window full of shoes goes dark for the night
You are exactly one of a hundred people

[chorus]
Shoulders and headlights, all of it moving
I'm Coming Home, the light is going to change
You step off the curb into the middle of it
And it carries you the way water would

[instrumental break]

[bridge]
You stopped being in a hurry three blocks back
You could walk this all night and not mind

[build]

[final chorus]
I'm Coming Home, the light is going to change
Shoulders and headlights, all of it moving
The neon lays itself across the wet street
And it carries you the way water would
I'm Coming Home, the light is going to change

[outro]

[intro]

[verse 1]
She pushes off the curb at half past two
The whole avenue is hers and no one else's
Green after green, the lights just let her go
A paper cup rolls somewhere behind her
Her jacket fills with air and lets it out

[chorus]
We Made It Through, the long way round
Streetlights running backward on the glass
Nothing left to answer for tonight

[breakdown]

The bridge is empty in both directions now
She takes both hands off and puts them back
A train goes over somewhere she can't see
The river holds the city upside down
The tunnel gives her back her own wheels

[chorus]
Streetlights running backward on the glass
We Made It Through, the long way round
Nothing left to answer for tonight
Just the sound of tyres and her own breath

Her keys are somewhere in the jacket, fine
Nothing left to answer for tonight
The sky is going grey behind the flats
